panels.description: Alex taps a framed image of Lina, Suri, Jalen and Ren laughing in a laboratory. Preserve the collaborative group and leave upper-left clear.
Alex’s daughter points at a framed compact-purifier patent drawing. Leave upper-right clear and render the diagram without readable extra text.
A scorched, cracked prototype hangs among the patents, visibly carrying Alex’s handwritten failure note as a later lettering/artifact element. Keep the damaged object unobstructed.
A faded brass PHANTUM WATERWORKS · ADRIAN PHANTUM, FOUNDER nameplate sits beside a newer Keel entrepreneur-center image. Keep both frames legible as artifacts without adding unapproved lettering.

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Made some. Fixed most. Worked with lots of people smarter than me.
